What is the GriidAI ecosystem

The GriidAI ecosystem brings together people and organizations interested in extending how geospatial AI is built, taught, shared, and applied. It connects technical contributions, education and research, community participation, and customer-facing partnerships around the GriidAI platform.

The four paths describe different ways to participate. You can express interest in more than one and discuss the right fit with the GriidAI team.

Contributors

Build with GriidAI

Contribute practical geospatial knowledge through tools and reusable workflows. If you have a useful analytical method, a repeatable sequence of GIS operations, or a tool that could help others solve spatial problems, tell us what you would like to build or share.

This path is for GIS practitioners, developers, data and AI engineers, researchers, and domain specialists who want to turn their expertise into reusable capabilities. You can start with an existing contribution or a well-defined idea.

Contribution options

Tools: propose a focused operation or utility that addresses a clear geospatial task.

Reusable workflows: describe a sequence of data preparation, analysis and output steps that others could adapt.

Practical documentation: explain required inputs, expected outputs, validation checks and known limitations so a contribution can be assessed and understood.

Explore how your work could reach relevant users, demonstrate your expertise, and develop through feedback. Tell us if you are interested in publication, verification, or commercial opportunities; the team can discuss what is available and the requirements for your contribution.

Sharing an idea starts a review conversation. Publication, verification and monetization depend on the agreed route and are not automatic outcomes of submitting interest.

Express Interest ↗
Education & Research

Bring geospatial AI into education and research

Explore how GriidAI could support teaching, student projects, research, workshops, and institutional learning. Connect spatial questions with data, analytical steps, and results that learners and researchers can inspect and discuss.

This path is for educators, researchers, universities, colleges, training providers, student groups, and individuals developing their geospatial skills. Tell us whether you are exploring a personal project, a classroom activity, or a wider institutional collaboration.

Education & research activities

Teaching and workshops: introduce geospatial AI through guided demonstrations, exercises and discussions of analytical methods.

Student projects: explore a defined spatial question and communicate the inputs, process and interpretation of the results.

Research collaboration: discuss a use case, method or evaluation where geospatial analysis can contribute.

Institutional learning: explore how a department, training provider or organization could include GriidAI in its learning activities.

Discuss the product access, practical guidance, learning resources, or collaboration support that could fit your proposed activity. The available support and participation arrangements will depend on the project and the agreed scope.

Education and research participation does not require you to act as a salesperson or content promoter. If you also want to teach publicly, mentor a community, or share your experience, you can express interest in the Ambassador route as well.

Community & Growth

Share expertise and connect opportunities

Help more people discover where GriidAI can be useful. This path brings together community participation, content-led recommendations, and introductions to organizations with a relevant need.

Choose the relationship that matches how you want to contribute. Ambassador, Affiliate and Referral Partner participation have different expectations and reward structures.

Ambassador

Share knowledge and support the community

For practitioners, educators, researchers, and community leaders who want to teach, create useful content, mentor others, share product feedback, or contribute to geospatial AI discussions. The focus is practical knowledge and an independent voice.

Read more

Ambassador participation centers on contribution, recognition and collaboration. Any access, activity support or compensation is agreed for the role; it is not a commission for each signup or referral.

Affiliate

Recommend GriidAI through your content

For creators, publishers, trainers, and community operators whose audiences may benefit from GriidAI. The Affiliate route is designed around tracked recommendations that lead to eligible paid subscriptions.

Read more

Affiliate participation uses performance-based rewards under agreed program terms. Tracking, qualifying subscriptions, commission rates and payment arrangements are confirmed before participation begins.

Referral Partner

Introduce a relevant business opportunity

For consultants, advisors, system integrators, complementary vendors, and professional networks that can make a qualified introduction to an organization with a relevant need.

Read more

Referral Partners introduce the opportunity and may help with discovery. GriidAI or the appropriate reseller manages the sale and customer relationship. Any referral reward depends on an accepted opportunity and the agreed terms.

Teaching or building community points toward Ambassador participation. Driving signups through content points toward Affiliate participation. Introducing a named organization points toward the Referral Partner route. If your work spans these activities, describe it in the form so we can discuss the appropriate arrangement.

Express Interest ↗
Solution & Reseller

Bring GriidAI to organizations

Help organizations apply geospatial AI to their work through professional services, implementation, integration, training, support, or local sales. This path is for consultancies, system integrators, geospatial service firms, and commercial partners with relevant customer relationships and delivery capability.

Solution delivery

Deliver expertise around the platform

If your strength is helping customers adopt technology, describe the services you can provide: use-case scoping, workflow development, integration, onboarding, training, or ongoing support. Tell us whether you want to deliver services independently or explore a closer collaboration with GriidAI.

Reseller

Carry the commercial relationship in your market

The Reseller route is for organizations prepared to manage the sales relationship and agreed responsibilities for local contracting, billing, first-line support, and renewals. It involves a deeper commercial and operational commitment than making an introduction.

Sales and renewal responsibilities

Explore how your market knowledge and customer expertise could combine with GriidAI. Technical enablement, joint opportunity development, marketing collaboration, and commercial arrangements are discussed according to the role, market and agreed scope.

You can express interest in services, reselling, or both. If you only want to introduce an opportunity and hand over the sale, select the Referral Partner route instead.

Explore the value of working together

A useful partnership starts with a clear contribution and the support needed to make it work. Depending on the participation route and agreed scope, a conversation with GriidAI can cover the following opportunities.

Product and technical guidance

Discuss the product access and technical guidance relevant to your contribution, learning activity, or customer engagement.

Learning and practical resources

Explore materials and guidance that could help you understand the platform and explain its use in your own context.

Recognition and visibility

Discuss opportunities to share relevant work, experience, or contributions with the wider community.

Collaboration and feedback

Connect around a defined project or activity and bring practical feedback into the conversation.

Business opportunities

For commercial routes, discuss how introductions, subscription recommendations, services, or resale could create value under agreed terms.

Benefits vary by route and agreement. Expressing interest does not automatically grant access, funding, partner status, publication, leads, or earnings.
